summary: Full-stack testing of WINEK MVP. Backend: 26/26 tests passing after fixing JSONB tag_ids parse bug. Frontend: All 7 screens tested and functional - Login, Register, Map, Search, Create, Profile, Bookings. Bilingual support (FR/EN) verified. Bottom tab navigation fully working. One frontend bug found: Create screen throws 'navigate before mount' error on direct URL navigation.

minor.issue: FIXED: asyncpg returned JSONB tag_ids field as string '[]' instead of Python list, causing DataError when used as array in SQL query. Fixed by adding json.loads() check in tagpoint_routes.py get_tag_point()

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect calls router.replace('/(auth)/login') before Root Layout is mounted when navigating directly to /create URL. Error: 'Attempted to navigate before mounting the Root Layout component'. Occurs because loading state from AuthContext is not checked before calling router. Fix: add 'loading' to useEffect dependencies and guard navigation with !loading check.

issues: Form only accessible via + tab button, not via direct URL when logged in (due to navigation-before-mount issue)

action_items: Fix create.tsx useEffect: add 'loading' from useAuth() and guard navigation with 'if (loading) return;' before the !user check. Also add loading/user to useEffect dependencies.
Consider adding global JSONB codec in database.py asyncpg pool setup to automatically decode JSONB fields as Python objects instead of relying on manual json.loads() checks in each route.
critical_code_review_comments: create.tsx: useEffect calls router.replace before auth state (loading) is resolved - missing 'loading' dependency check similar to index.tsx pattern

tagpoint_routes.py: JSONB fields (tag_ids) returned as strings by asyncpg without a global JSON codec - patched in get_tag_point() but same pattern exists in service_routes.py and other routes that may use tag_ids lists
JWT secret is only 28 bytes ('winek-jwt-secret-2024-secure') - below recommended 32 bytes minimum for HS256; warnings visible in backend logs
profile.tsx lists TEST_ prefixed TagPoints from automated tests - no concern for production as test data will not exist there

Create screen shows error on direct URL navigation. Auth flow (login->map) works correctly. Bilingual FR/EN verified on Register and Profile screens.
rca_of_issue: Bug: GET /api/tag-points/{point_id} returned 500. RCA: asyncpg by default does not automatically decode JSONB columns to Python objects. The tag_ids column (JSONB) inserted via json.dumps() was returned as the string '[]', not as a Python list. When the route tried to pass this string to asyncpg as an array parameter ($1::text[]), asyncpg threw DataError. Fix: added isinstance check + json.loads() before using tag_ids_list in SQL query. Mitigation for future: set up asyncpg JSONB codec globally in connect_to_db().
